messages:
olivia-sales: FYI Prospect OrionWorks wants to start a 10-day POC but procurement requires SOC2 summary + ISO cert + signed pen-test attestation before staging creds. Can we deliver this week?

raj-se: I can grab the SOC2 summary and a redacted control matrix. We usually remove org/user identifiers.

elaine-security: We can provide SOC2 Type II summary + redacted matrix. For full report we need NDA + secure transfer. ISO cert PDF ok.

kevin-ps: They want a pen-test attestation with a named signer for procurement. Do we have a signed template?

elaine-security: Yesstandard attestation: "Redwood Inference confirms a third-party penetration test was completed on YYYY-MM and no critical open findings were present at that time." I can sign as Director of Security.

artifact-bot: action: presigned S3 link (7d) created by devex  DM'd to olivia-sales (link hidden).

olivia-sales: Also asking for eu-only data for the POC (eu-west-1). For short trials can we guarantee region? Pricing may change.

raj-se: We can run Hosted in eu-west-1 for a short POC with network isolation. Delta applies; estimate ~1.7x for the slice. I'll send numbers tomorrow.

elaine-security: KMS note: Dedicated/Private supports customer-managed keys. For Hosted demos we use ephemeral keys; KMS separation for POC needs ~72h ops prep.

olivia-sales: Next steps: 1) elaine upload signed attestation to presigned link TODAY, 2) devex upload SOC2 summary + ISO cert TODAY, 3) raj share eu pricing delta TOMORROW, 4) kevin propose audit walkthrough if they want deeper review.

kevin-ps: Tentative walkthrough slot Thurs 09:00 UTC. I'll confirm with OrionWorks.

olivia-sales: Thanks team ":thumbsup:"
